payload.register:
R1 MILESTONE COMMIT (functional). WHEN a gate is blessed for a worktree-resident iteration, SE SHALL commit that iteration's working state to its own branch. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: work stays uncommitted until a close that may write nothing, and losing the working directory destroys it - the i8c failure. source_refs: UC-B, S3, note-989ab09c39b0.

R2 EMPTY-BRANCH REFUSAL (functional). WHEN closing an iteration whose branch carries no commits beyond its fork point, SE SHALL refuse the close and leave trunk unchanged. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: a close reports merged while producing no commit - exactly how i8c shipped nothing. source_refs: UC-A ext 1a, S4.

R3 TAG BEFORE MERGE (functional). WHEN closing an iteration, SE SHALL create the tag iter/<id> on the branch tip BEFORE the merge is committed. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: the events lose their only named handle at the moment they leave the tree. source_refs: UC-A step 2, se-v2-design §4.

R4 REFUSE ON UNTAGGABLE (functional, unwanted-behaviour). IF the tag cannot be created, THEN SE SHALL refuse the close before merging anything. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: content can leave trunk with nothing naming where it went - risk R1. source_refs: UC-A ext 2a.

R5 FILTERED MERGE TREE (functional). WHEN closing an iteration, SE SHALL produce a merge commit with two parents whose tree contains no evidence, machines or state files for that iteration. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: trunk keeps collecting the record - 57 evidence files in one commit today. source_refs: UC-A steps 3-5, S1, prop 1.

R6 EVENTS REMAIN REACHABLE (functional). AFTER a close, SE SHALL leave every event file readable through the created tag. verify_method: test (git show iter/<id>:<path> returns content trunk does not have). breaks_if_removed: the split becomes deletion. source_refs: UC-A success guarantee, S2, prop 2.

R7 POINTER CARRIES THE TAG (interface). WHEN a gate is blessed, SE SHALL record on the grant the tag under which that evidence will be reachable. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: every evidence pointer dangles the moment evidence leaves trunk - risk R3. Note: the tag name is deterministic (iter/<id>), so it is knowable at bless time, before the tag exists. source_refs: UC-C, design floor items 3-4.

R8 CONFLICT ABORTS (functional). WHILE a merge conflicts on a live claim, SE SHALL abort it and leave trunk unchanged. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: a conflict could be silently resolved by dropping paths, which is data loss disguised as a merge. source_refs: UC-A ext 3a. (Existing behaviour; stated so the filter cannot regress it.)

R9 VERIFIABLE WORKTREE (functional). WHEN an iteration is provisioned, SE SHALL ensure the verify toolchain resolves from inside the new worktree. verify_method: demonstration (a fresh worktree runs the full verify with no manual repair). breaks_if_removed: every new iteration's first battery dies at tsc - se.raid-worktree-provisioning-incomplete. source_refs: UC-D, S6.

R10 STALE-FORK WARNING (functional, unwanted-behaviour). IF trunk carries uncommitted engine changes when an iteration opens, THEN SE SHALL say so at open. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: the worktree forks from a state that does not match the running engine, which cost i8c two failed batteries. source_refs: UC-D ext 3a.

R11 NO HISTORY REWRITING (constraint). SE SHALL NOT rebase, force-push or amend published history. verify_method: inspection plus the existing refusal test. breaks_if_removed: superseded content that lives only in history can be destroyed - the design's operational rule. binding norm: se-v2-design §4 branch-isolation.

R12 ARCHIVE STAYS LISTABLE (functional). AFTER a close, the closed iteration SHALL remain listable from the grant index on trunk. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: filtering the tree would make closed iterations vanish from the board entirely - the regression the PR-FAQ caught. source_refs: S5, folded finding.

Q1 CLOSE ATOMICITY (quality: reliability). Six-part scenario - SOURCE: the driving agent closing unattended. STIMULUS: any step of the close fails (no commits, tag refused, merge conflict). ARTIFACT: the close path. ENVIRONMENT: normal unattended operation. RESPONSE: trunk is left exactly as it was, and the failure is named. MEASURE: after any induced failure, trunk's HEAD is unchanged and no partial merge remains. verify_method: test. breaks_if_removed: a half-applied close is the worst state - some events gone, some claims merged, no name on either.
payload.set_criteria: COMPLETE against the use cases: every main-scenario step and every numbered extension of UC-A, UC-B, UC-C and UC-D maps to at least one requirement, and the folded no-regression need is R12. CONSISTENT: the only tension is speed of close versus safety, and it is resolved uniformly - R2, R4, R8 and Q1 all refuse rather than proceed, so no requirement asks the close to continue past a failure. AFFORDABLE: eleven functional/interface requirements plus one quality and one constraint, all inside one engine file plus the bless path; the git operations are ordinary and the only genuinely unproven mechanic (R5's filtered tree) is deliberately spiked at M6 rather than assumed. BOUNDED: nothing here reads back from git, migrates existing iterations, or touches the machine, the board or the meaning of a gate - the binding excluded list holds, and R12 is deliberately the minimum that prevents a regression rather than the beginning of i5e.
